channelHint.release: Tested builds. Recommended for a house people actually live in.
channelHint.dev: Fresh builds straight from development. New things sooner, rough edges more likely.

channelSwitched: Switched to the "{{channel}}" channel. Available versions refreshed.
atomicGroup: These update together: the intermediate state between them is incompatible.
nothingToDo: Nothing to update — everything is current.
willBackup: A backup will be taken before updating.
willNotBackup: Backup before update is disabled in settings.
uiWillRestart: The interface restarts on the final step — this page will reconnect on its own.
unavailable: The delivery service is unavailable. Updating from the interface will not work; the rest of the stack is unaffected.

errors.plan: Could not build the update plan
